title: "invalid_actor_definition"
description: "An actor definition is missing a required part or is not an actor contract."
---

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-docs.mts from the website's docs. Do not edit: run `pnpm docs:gen`. -->

**What happened:** An actor definition is missing a required part or is not an actor contract.

**How to fix it:** Define actors with `kit.actor(name, { input, init, roles, views, ... })` and pass the contract it returns.

Thrown as an `ActorKitError` (or a subclass) whose `code` is this one and whose `docs` is this page.

The error's `message` names the specifics (the message, state, binding or value involved). See all [error codes](/errors/).
